## History

Flora Jane is mentioned during a discussion regarding the care of children when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to address an orphanage mix-up. Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant, bringing up Flora Jane's experience and workload in her household.

## Relationships

### [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

Flora Jane is the child of Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) travel to Mrs. Spencer's home to address a mix-up regarding the orphan child, Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) is present while alternative arrangements, such as placing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), are discussed.
